sentences.text: The petitioner has filed this original petition challenging Ext.P5 order of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Thaliparamba whereby Ext.P2 claim petition filed by the petitioner and minor children under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been returned for the reason that it has been filed beyond the period of limitation.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the Insurance Company.

3. In the light of the order of the Apex Court dated 04.11.2025 in SLP (C) Nos.8412-8413 of 2023 [ICICI Lombard General Insurance Co.Ltd. v. Ayiti Navaneedta], there will be a direction to the petitioner to re-present the claim petition before the Tribunal within two weeks from today.
